name: Library pony
tips: `man` opens the manual of a command. `man woman` answers "No manual entry for woman": a very old Unix joke.
Manuals have sections: 1 for commands, 5 for file formats. `man 5 passwd` reads the file format, not the command.
`man -k word` (or `apropos word`) finds the manual pages that talk about a word.
personal: Every answer is in a manual somewhere.
I like quiet terminals and long man pages.
